triples.tail_surface: Gouges or marks made by large, hard particles; a rapid wearing away of bushings from very small abrasives; or anything in between.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 大硬颗粒造成的划痕或痕迹；微小磨料导致衬套快速磨损；或介于两者之间的情况
triples.evidence_text: SEVISARBA Gouges or marks made by large, hard particles; a rapid wearing away of bushings from very small abrasives; or anything in between.

triples.tail_surface: Rust, pitting or metal appears to be “eaten” away.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 锈蚀、点蚀或金属被“侵蚀”
triples.evidence_text: NOISORROC Rust, pitting or metal appears to be “eaten” away.

triples.tail_surface: Noisy operation, broken bushings, twisted shaft, parts show evidence of high heat (discoloration).
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 运行噪声大、衬套断裂、轴扭曲、零件显示高温迹象（变色）
triples.evidence_text: GNIDEECXE GNITAREPO STIMIL Noisy operation, broken bushings, twisted shaft, parts show evidence of high heat (discoloration).

triples.tail_surface: Pump may stall. Evidence of heavy contact between end of rotor teeth and head or other parts.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 泵可能失速；转子齿端与泵头或其他零件之间有严重接触痕迹
triples.evidence_text: TNEICIFFUSNI ARTXE ECNARAELC Pump may stall. Evidence of heavy contact between end of rotor teeth and head or other parts.

triples.tail_surface: Noisy bearings, localized heating at bearings or lip seal, smoke, rapid bushing wear.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 轴承噪声大、轴承或唇封局部发热、冒烟、衬套快速磨损
triples.evidence_text: FO KCAL NOITACIRBUL Noisy bearings, localized heating at bearings or lip seal, smoke, rapid bushing wear.

triples.tail_surface: Wear on only one part of a surface, e.g., one side of the casing, one side of the packing gland, only a portion of the face of the head.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 表面仅单侧磨损，例如壳体一侧、填料函一侧或泵头端面局部
triples.evidence_text: TNEMNGILASIM Wear on only one part of a surface, e.g., one side of the casing, one side of the packing gland, only a portion of the face of the head.

triples.tail_surface: Pump stalls because parts have uneven expansion caused by frictional heat; galling between surfaces having relative motion; seal seats and idler pins changing color because of high heat.
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 因摩擦热导致零件不均匀膨胀而停转；相对运动表面间发生咬合；密封座和惰轮销因高温变色
triples.evidence_text: YRD NUR Pump stalls because parts have uneven expansion caused by frictional heat; galling between surfaces having relative motion; seal seats and idler pins changing color because of high heat.
